verses.original: δὲ ἀδελφοί Γνωρίζω ὑμῖν τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ὃ εὐηγγελισάμην ὑμῖν ὃ καὶ παρελάβετε καὶ ἐν ᾧ ἑστήκατε
verses.transliteration: de adelphoi Gnōrizō hymin to euangelion ho euēngelisamēn hymin ho kai parelabete kai en hō hestēkate
verses.literal: Now brothers I want to remind you [of] the gospel - I preached to you which - you received and in which you stand firm

verses.original: δι’ οὗ καὶ σῴζεσθε εἰ κατέχετε τίνι λόγῳ εὐηγγελισάμην ὑμῖν ἐκτὸς εἰ μὴ ἐπιστεύσατε εἰκῇ
verses.transliteration: di’ hou kai sōzesthe ei katechete tini logō euēngelisamēn hymin ektos ei mē episteusate eikē
verses.literal: By [this gospel] - you are saved if you hold firmly to the word I preached to you Otherwise . . . . . . you have believed in vain

verses.original: γὰρ ὃ καὶ παρέλαβον Παρέδωκα ὑμῖν ἐν πρώτοις ὅτι Χριστὸς ἀπέθανεν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν κατὰ τὰς γραφάς
verses.transliteration: gar ho kai parelabon Paredōka hymin en prōtois hoti Christos apethanen hyper hēmōn tōn hamartiōn kata tas graphas
verses.literal: For what - I received I passed on to you as of first importance that Christ died for our - sins according to the Scriptures

verses.original: καὶ ὅτι ἐτάφη καὶ ὅτι ἐγήγερται τῇ τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ κατὰ τὰς γραφάς
verses.transliteration: kai hoti etaphē kai hoti egēgertai tē tē tritē hēmera kata tas graphas
verses.literal: - that He was buried - that He was raised on the - third day according to the Scriptures

verses.original: καὶ ὅτι ὤφθη Κηφᾷ εἶτα τοῖς δώδεκα
verses.transliteration: kai hoti ōphthē Kēpha eita tois dōdeka
verses.literal: and that He appeared to Cephas [and] then to the Twelve

verses.original: ἔπειτα ὤφθη ἐπάνω πεντακοσίοις ἀδελφοῖς ἐφάπαξ οἱ πλείονες ἐξ ὧν μένουσιν ἕως ἄρτι δὲ τινὲς ἐκοιμήθησαν
verses.transliteration: epeita ōphthē epanō pentakosiois adelphois ephapax hoi pleiones ex hōn menousin heōs arti de tines ekoimēthēsan
verses.literal: After that He appeared to more than five hundred brothers at once - most of whom are still living . . . . . . though some have fallen asleep

verses.original: ἔπειτα ὤφθη Ἰακώβῳ εἶτα πᾶσιν τοῖς ἀποστόλοις
verses.transliteration: epeita ōphthē Iakōbō eita pasin tois apostolois
verses.literal: Then He appeared to James then to all the apostles

verses.original: δὲ ἔσχατον πάντων ὤφθη κἀμοί ὡσπερεὶ τῷ ἐκτρώματι
verses.transliteration: de eschaton pantōn ōphthē kamoi hōsperei tō ektrōmati
verses.literal: And last of all He appeared to me also as to [one] of untimely birth

verses.original: γάρ Ἐγὼ εἰμι ὁ ἐλάχιστος τῶν ἀποστόλων ὃς εἰμὶ οὐκ ἱκανὸς καλεῖσθαι ἀπόστολος διότι ἐδίωξα τὴν ἐκκλησίαν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar Egō eimi ho elachistos tōn apostolōn hos eimi ouk hikanos kaleisthai apostolos dioti ediōxa tēn ekklēsian tou Theou
verses.literal: For I am the least of the apostles [and] am vvv unworthy to be called an apostle because I persecuted the church - of God

verses.original: δὲ χάριτι Θεοῦ εἰμι ὅ εἰμι καὶ αὐτοῦ ἡ χάρις ἡ εἰς ἐμὲ οὐ ἐγενήθη κενὴ ἀλλὰ ἐκοπίασα περισσότερον πάντων αὐτῶν δὲ οὐκ ἐγὼ ἀλλὰ ἡ χάρις τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡ σὺν ἐμοί
verses.transliteration: de chariti Theou eimi ho eimi kai autou hē charis hē eis eme ou egenēthē kenē alla ekopiasa perissoteron pantōn autōn de ouk egō alla hē charis tou Theou hē syn emoi
verses.literal: But [by the] grace of God I am what I am and His - grace - to me vvv was not in vain No I worked harder vvv than all of them yet not I but the grace - of God that [was] with me

verses.original: εἴτε οὖν ἐγὼ εἴτε ἐκεῖνοι οὕτως κηρύσσομεν καὶ οὕτως ἐπιστεύσατε
verses.transliteration: eite oun egō eite ekeinoi houtōs kēryssomen kai houtōs episteusate
verses.literal: Whether then [it was] I or they this is what we preach and this is what you believed

verses.original: δὲ Εἰ κηρύσσεται ὅτι Χριστὸς ἐγήγερται ἐκ νεκρῶν πῶς τινες ἐν ὑμῖν λέγουσιν ὅτι ἔστιν οὐκ ἀνάστασις νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: de Ei kēryssetai hoti Christos egēgertai ek nekrōn pōs tines en hymin legousin hoti estin ouk anastasis nekrōn
verses.literal: But if it is preached that Christ has been raised from [the] dead how {can} some of you say that there is no resurrection of [the] dead

verses.original: δὲ εἰ ἔστιν οὐκ ἀνάστασις νεκρῶν οὐδὲ Χριστὸς ἐγήγερται
verses.transliteration: de ei estin ouk anastasis nekrōn oude Christos egēgertai
verses.literal: - If there is no resurrection of [the] dead [then] not even Christ has been raised

verses.original: δὲ εἰ Χριστὸς οὐκ ἐγήγερται ἄρα καὶ ἡμῶν τὸ κήρυγμα κενὸν καὶ κενὴ ὑμῶν ἡ πίστις
verses.transliteration: de ei Christos ouk egēgertai ara kai hēmōn to kērygma kenon kai kenē hymōn hē pistis
verses.literal: And if Christ vvv has not been raised - - our - preaching [is] worthless and [so is] your - faith

verses.original: δὲ καὶ εὑρισκόμεθα ψευδομάρτυρες τοῦ Θεοῦ ὅτι ἐμαρτυρήσαμεν κατὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ ὅτι ἤγειρεν τὸν Χριστόν οὐκ ἤγειρεν ὃν εἴπερ ἄρα νεκροὶ οὐκ ἐγείρονται
verses.transliteration: de kai heuriskometha pseudomartyres tou Theou hoti emartyrēsamen kata tou Theou hoti ēgeiren ton Christon ouk ēgeiren hon eiper ara nekroi ouk egeirontai
verses.literal: In that case vvv we are also exposed as false witnesses - about God For we have testified about - God that He raised - Christ {from the dead} vvv [but] He did not raise [Him] if in fact [the] dead vvv are not raised

verses.original: γὰρ Εἰ νεκροὶ οὐκ ἐγείρονται οὐδὲ Χριστὸς ἐγήγερται
verses.transliteration: gar Ei nekroi ouk egeirontai oude Christos egēgertai
verses.literal: For if [the] dead vvv are not raised then not even Christ has been raised

verses.original: δὲ εἰ Χριστὸς οὐκ ἐγήγερται ὑμῶν ἡ πίστις ἐστίν ματαία ἐστὲ ἔτι ἐν ὑμῶν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις
verses.transliteration: de ei Christos ouk egēgertai hymōn hē pistis estin mataia este eti en hymōn tais hamartiais
verses.literal: And if Christ vvv has not been raised your - faith is futile you are still in your - sins

verses.original: ἄρα οἱ καὶ κοιμηθέντες ἐν Χριστῷ ἀπώλοντο
verses.transliteration: ara hoi kai koimēthentes en Christō apōlonto
verses.literal: Then those also {who} have fallen asleep in Christ have perished

verses.original: εἰ ἐσμὲν ἠλπικότες ἐν Χριστῷ ἐν ταύτῃ τῇ ζωῇ μόνον ἐσμέν ἐλεεινότεροι πάντων ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: ei esmen ēlpikotes en Christō en tautē tē zōē monon esmen eleeinoteroi pantōn anthrōpōn
verses.literal: If our hope in Christ [is] for this - life alone we are to be pitied more than all men

verses.original: δὲ Χριστὸς Νυνὶ ἐγήγερται ἐκ νεκρῶν ἀπαρχὴ τῶν κεκοιμημένων
verses.transliteration: de Christos Nyni egēgertai ek nekrōn aparchē tōn kekoimēmenōn
verses.literal: But Christ {has} indeed been raised from [the] dead [the] firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep

verses.original: γὰρ ἐπειδὴ θάνατος δι’ ἀνθρώπου ἀνάστασις νεκρῶν καὶ δι’ ἀνθρώπου
verses.transliteration: gar epeidē thanatos di’ anthrōpou anastasis nekrōn kai di’ anthrōpou
verses.literal: For since death [came] through a man [the] resurrection of [the] dead [comes] also through a man

verses.original: ὥσπερ γὰρ ἐν τῷ Ἀδὰμ πάντες ἀποθνήσκουσιν οὕτως καὶ ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ πάντες ζωοποιηθήσονται
verses.transliteration: hōsper gar en tō Adam pantes apothnēskousin houtōs kai en tō Christō pantes zōopoiēthēsontai
verses.literal: For as - in - Adam all die so . . . in - Christ all will be made alive

verses.original: δὲ Ἕκαστος ἐν τῷ ἰδίῳ τάγματι Χριστός ἀπαρχὴ ἔπειτα ἐν αὐτοῦ τῇ παρουσίᾳ οἱ τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: de Hekastos en tō idiō tagmati Christos aparchē epeita en autou tē parousia hoi tou Christou
verses.literal: But each in [his] own turn Christ [the] firstfruits then at His - coming those who belong to [Him]

verses.original: εἶτα τὸ τέλος ὅταν παραδιδῷ τὴν βασιλείαν τῷ Θεῷ καὶ Πατρί ὅταν καταργήσῃ πᾶσαν ἀρχὴν καὶ πᾶσαν ἐξουσίαν καὶ δύναμιν
verses.transliteration: eita to telos hotan paradidō tēn basileian tō Theō kai Patri hotan katargēsē pasan archēn kai pasan exousian kai dynamin
verses.literal: Then the end [will come] when He hands over the kingdom - to God [the] Father after He has destroyed all dominion - - authority and power

verses.original: γὰρ αὐτὸν δεῖ βασιλεύειν ἄχρι οὗ θῇ πάντας τοὺς ἐχθροὺς ὑπὸ αὐτοῦ τοὺς πόδας
verses.transliteration: gar auton dei basileuein achri hou thē pantas tous echthrous hypo autou tous podas
verses.literal: For He must reign until . . . He has put all [His] enemies under His - feet

verses.original: ἔσχατος ἐχθρὸς καταργεῖται ὁ θάνατος
verses.transliteration: eschatos echthros katargeitai ho thanatos
verses.literal: [The] last enemy to be destroyed [is] - death

verses.original: γὰρ Ὑπέταξεν Πάντα ὑπὸ αὐτοῦ τοὺς πόδας δὲ ὅταν εἴπῃ ὅτι πάντα ὑποτέτακται ὅτι δῆλον ἐκτὸς τοῦ ὑποτάξαντος τὰ πάντα αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: gar Hypetaxen Panta hypo autou tous podas de hotan eipē hoti panta hypotetaktai hoti dēlon ektos tou hypotaxantos ta panta autō
verses.literal: For [God] has put everything under His - feet Now when it says that everything has been put under Him this clearly [does] not include the [One who] put everything under . . . . . . Him

verses.original: δὲ ὅταν τὰ πάντα ὑποταγῇ αὐτῷ τότε καὶ ὁ Υἱὸς αὐτὸς ὑποταγήσεται τῷ ὑποτάξαντι τὰ πάντα αὐτῷ ἵνα ὁ Θεὸς τὰ ᾖ πάντα ἐν πᾶσιν
verses.transliteration: de hotan ta panta hypotagē autō tote kai ho Huios autos hypotagēsetai tō hypotaxanti ta panta autō hina ho Theos ta ē panta en pasin
verses.literal: And when - all things have been subjected to Him then - the Son Himself will be made subject to Him who put - all things {under} Him so that - God - may be all in all

verses.original: Ἐπεὶ τί ποιήσουσιν οἱ βαπτιζόμενοι ὑπὲρ τῶν νεκρῶν εἰ νεκροὶ οὐκ ἐγείρονται ὅλως τί καὶ βαπτίζονται ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Epei ti poiēsousin hoi baptizomenoi hyper tōn nekrōn ei nekroi ouk egeirontai holōs ti kai baptizontai hyper autōn
verses.literal: If [these things are] not so what will those do who are baptized for the dead If [the] dead vvv are not raised at all why - are [people] baptized for them

verses.original: καὶ τί ἡμεῖς κινδυνεύομεν πᾶσαν ὥραν
verses.transliteration: kai ti hēmeis kindyneuomen pasan hōran
verses.literal: And why {do} we endanger ourselves every hour

verses.original: ἀποθνῄσκω καθ’ ἡμέραν ἀδελφοί νὴ τὴν ἣν ἔχω καύχησιν ὑμετέραν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ἡμῶν τῷ Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: apothnēskō kath’ hēmeran adelphoi nē tēn hēn echō kauchēsin hymeteran en Christō Iēsou hēmōn tō Kyriō
verses.literal: I face death every day brothers as surely as - - vvv I boast about you in Christ Jesus our - Lord

verses.original: εἰ ἐθηριομάχησα ἐν Ἐφέσῳ κατὰ ἄνθρωπον τί τὸ ὄφελος μοι εἰ νεκροὶ οὐκ ἐγείρονται Φάγωμεν καὶ πίωμεν γὰρ αὔριον ἀποθνήσκομεν
verses.transliteration: ei ethēriomachēsa en Ephesō kata anthrōpon ti to ophelos moi ei nekroi ouk egeirontai Phagōmen kai piōmen gar aurion apothnēskomen
verses.literal: If I fought wild beasts in Ephesus for human [motives] what - did I gain . . . If [the] dead vvv are not raised Let us eat and drink for tomorrow we die

verses.original: Μὴ πλανᾶσθε κακαί ὁμιλίαι Φθείρουσιν χρηστὰ ἤθη
verses.transliteration: Mē planasthe kakai homiliai Phtheirousin chrēsta ēthē
verses.literal: {Do} not be deceived Bad company corrupts good character

verses.original: ἐκνήψατε δικαίως καὶ μὴ ἁμαρτάνετε γὰρ τινες ἔχουσιν ἀγνωσίαν Θεοῦ λαλῶ πρὸς ὑμῖν ἐντροπὴν
verses.transliteration: eknēpsate dikaiōs kai mē hamartanete gar tines echousin agnōsian Theou lalō pros hymin entropēn
verses.literal: Sober up as you ought and vvv stop sinning for some [ of you ] vvv are ignorant of God I say this to your shame

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ τις ἐρεῖ Πῶς οἱ νεκροί ἐγείρονται δὲ ποίῳ σώματι ἔρχονται
verses.transliteration: Alla tis erei Pōs hoi nekroi egeirontai de poiō sōmati erchontai
verses.literal: But someone will ask How {are} the dead raised - With what kind of body will they come

verses.original: σὺ ἄφρων ὃ σπείρεις οὐ ζωοποιεῖται ἐὰν μὴ ἀποθάνῃ
verses.transliteration: sy aphrōn ho speireis ou zōopoieitai ean mē apothanē
verses.literal: You fool What you sow vvv does not come to life unless . . . it dies

verses.original: καὶ ὃ σπείρεις οὐ τὸ σῶμα τὸ γενησόμενον ἀλλὰ σπείρεις γυμνὸν κόκκον εἰ τύχοι σίτου ἤ τινος τῶν λοιπῶν
verses.transliteration: kai ho speireis ou to sōma to genēsomenon alla speireis gymnon kokkon ei tychoi sitou ē tinos tōn loipōn
verses.literal: And what you sow [is] not the body that will be but [just] vvv a seed perhaps . . . of wheat or something - else

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Θεὸς δίδωσιν αὐτῷ σῶμα καθὼς ἠθέλησεν καὶ ἑκάστῳ τῶν σπερμάτων ἴδιον σῶμα
verses.transliteration: de ho Theos didōsin autō sōma kathōs ēthelēsen kai hekastō tōn spermatōn idion sōma
verses.literal: But - God gives it a body as He has designed and to each [kind] of seed [He gives] its own body

verses.original: Οὐ πᾶσα σὰρξ ἡ αὐτὴ ἀλλὰ μὲν ἀνθρώπων ἄλλη σάρξ δὲ κτηνῶν ἄλλη σὰρξ δὲ πτηνῶν ἄλλη σὰρξ δὲ ἰχθύων ἄλλη
verses.transliteration: Ou pasa sarx hē autē alla men anthrōpōn allē sarx de ktēnōn allē sarx de ptēnōn allē sarx de ichthyōn allē
verses.literal: Not all flesh [is] the same - - Men [have] one [kind of] flesh - animals [have] another - - birds another - and fish another

verses.original: καὶ ἐπουράνια σώματα καὶ ἐπίγεια σώματα ἀλλὰ μὲν ἡ δόξα τῶν ἐπουρανίων ἑτέρα δὲ ἡ τῶν ἐπιγείων ἑτέρα
verses.transliteration: kai epourania sōmata kai epigeia sōmata alla men hē doxa tōn epouraniōn hetera de hē tōn epigeiōn hetera
verses.literal: [There are] also heavenly bodies and earthly bodies But - the splendor of the heavenly [bodies] [is of] one [degree] and [the splendor] of the earthly [bodies] [is of] another

verses.original: ἡλίου ἄλλη δόξα καὶ σελήνης ἄλλη δόξα καὶ ἀστέρων ἄλλη δόξα γὰρ ἀστὴρ διαφέρει ἀστέρος ἐν δόξῃ
verses.transliteration: hēliou allē doxa kai selēnēs allē doxa kai asterōn allē doxa gar astēr diapherei asteros en doxē
verses.literal: [The] sun [has] one [degree of] splendor - [the] moon another - and [the] stars another - and star differs from star in splendor

verses.original: Οὕτως καὶ ἡ ἀνάστασις τῶν νεκρῶν σπείρεται ἐν φθορᾷ ἐγείρεται ἐν ἀφθαρσίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Houtōs kai hē anastasis tōn nekrōn speiretai en phthora egeiretai en aphtharsia
verses.literal: So [will it be] with the resurrection of the dead What is sown [is] vvv perishable it is raised vvv imperishable

verses.original: σπείρεται ἐν ἀτιμίᾳ ἐγείρεται ἐν δόξῃ σπείρεται ἐν ἀσθενείᾳ ἐγείρεται ἐν δυνάμει
verses.transliteration: speiretai en atimia egeiretai en doxē speiretai en astheneia egeiretai en dynamei
verses.literal: It is sown in dishonor it is raised in glory It is sown in weakness it is raised in power

verses.original: σπείρεται ψυχικόν σῶμα ἐγείρεται πνευματικόν σῶμα Εἰ ἔστιν ψυχικόν σῶμα ἔστιν καὶ πνευματικόν
verses.transliteration: speiretai psychikon sōma egeiretai pneumatikon sōma Ei estin psychikon sōma estin kai pneumatikon
verses.literal: It is sown a natural body it is raised a spiritual body If there is a natural body there is also a spiritual [body]

verses.original: καὶ οὕτως γέγραπται ὁ πρῶτος ἄνθρωπος Ἀδὰμ Ἐγένετο εἰς ζῶσαν ψυχὴν ὁ ἔσχατος Ἀδὰμ εἰς ζωοποιοῦν πνεῦμα
verses.transliteration: kai houtōs gegraptai ho prōtos anthrōpos Adam Egeneto eis zōsan psychēn ho eschatos Adam eis zōopoioun pneuma
verses.literal: - So it is written The first man Adam became . . . a living being the last Adam - a life-giving spirit

verses.original: τὸ πνευματικὸν Ἀλλ’ οὐ πρῶτον ἀλλὰ τὸ ψυχικόν ἔπειτα τὸ πνευματικόν
verses.transliteration: to pneumatikon All’ ou prōton alla to psychikon epeita to pneumatikon
verses.literal: The spiritual however [was] not first but the natural and then the spiritual

verses.original: ὁ πρῶτος ἄνθρωπος χοϊκός ἐκ γῆς ὁ δεύτερος ἄνθρωπος ἐξ οὐρανοῦ
verses.transliteration: ho prōtos anthrōpos choikos ek gēs ho deuteros anthrōpos ex ouranou
verses.literal: The first man [was] of the dust of [the] earth the second man from heaven

verses.original: οἷος ὁ χοϊκός τοιοῦτοι καὶ οἱ χοϊκοί καὶ οἷος ὁ ἐπουράνιος τοιοῦτοι καὶ οἱ ἐπουράνιοι
verses.transliteration: hoios ho choikos toioutoi kai hoi choikoi kai hoios ho epouranios toioutoi kai hoi epouranioi
verses.literal: As [was] the earthly [man] so also [are] those who are of the earth and as [is] the heavenly [man] so also [are] those who are of heaven

verses.original: καὶ καθὼς ἐφορέσαμεν τὴν εἰκόνα τοῦ χοϊκοῦ καὶ φορέσομεν τὴν εἰκόνα τοῦ ἐπουρανίου
verses.transliteration: kai kathōs ephoresamen tēn eikona tou choikou kai phoresomen tēn eikona tou epouraniou
verses.literal: And just as we have borne the likeness of the earthly [man] so also shall we bear the likeness of the heavenly [man]

verses.original: δέ φημι Τοῦτο ἀδελφοί ὅτι σὰρξ καὶ αἷμα οὐ δύναται κληρονομῆσαι βασιλείαν Θεοῦ οὐδὲ ἡ φθορὰ κληρονομεῖ τὴν ἀφθαρσίαν
verses.transliteration: de phēmi Touto adelphoi hoti sarx kai haima ou dynatai klēronomēsai basileian Theou oude hē phthora klēronomei tēn aphtharsian
verses.literal: Now I declare [to you] - brothers that flesh and blood vvv cannot inherit [the] kingdom of God nor {does} the perishable inherit the imperishable

verses.original: Ἰδοὺ λέγω ὑμῖν μυστήριον οὐ πάντες κοιμηθησόμεθα δὲ πάντες ἀλλαγησόμεθα
verses.transliteration: Idou legō hymin mystērion ou pantes koimēthēsometha de pantes allagēsometha
verses.literal: Listen I tell you a mystery {We will} not all sleep but vvv we will all be changed

verses.original: ἐν ἀτόμῳ ἐν ῥιπῇ ὀφθαλμοῦ ἐν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ σάλπιγγι γάρ σαλπίσει καὶ οἱ νεκροὶ ἐγερθήσονται ἄφθαρτοι καὶ ἡμεῖς ἀλλαγησόμεθα
verses.transliteration: en atomō en rhipē ophthalmou en tē eschatē salpingi gar salpisei kai hoi nekroi egerthēsontai aphthartoi kai hēmeis allagēsometha
verses.literal: in an instant in [the] twinkling of an eye at the last trumpet For the trumpet will sound - the dead will be raised imperishable and we will be changed

verses.original: γὰρ τὸ φθαρτὸν δεῖ τοῦτο ἐνδύσασθαι ἀφθαρσίαν καὶ τοῦτο τὸ θνητὸν ἐνδύσασθαι ἀθανασίαν
verses.transliteration: gar to phtharton dei touto endysasthai aphtharsian kai touto to thnēton endysasthai athanasian
verses.literal: For the perishable must - be clothed with [the] imperishable and - the mortal [with] immortality

verses.original: δὲ Ὅταν τοῦτο τὸ φθαρτὸν ἐνδύσηται τὴν ἀφθαρσίαν καὶ τοῦτο τὸ θνητὸν ἐνδύσηται ἀθανασίαν τότε ὁ λόγος ὁ γεγραμμένος γενήσεται ὁ θάνατος Κατεπόθη εἰς νῖκος
verses.transliteration: de Hotan touto to phtharton endysētai tēn aphtharsian kai touto to thnēton endysētai athanasian tote ho logos ho gegrammenos genēsetai ho thanatos Katepothē eis nikos
verses.literal: - When - the perishable has been clothed with the imperishable and - the mortal [with] immortality then the saying that is written will come to pass - Death has been swallowed up in victory

verses.original: Ποῦ θάνατε σου τὸ νῖκος ποῦ θάνατε σου τὸ κέντρον
verses.transliteration: Pou thanate sou to nikos pou thanate sou to kentron
verses.literal: Where O Death [is] your - victory Where O Death [is] your - sting

verses.original: δὲ Τὸ κέντρον τοῦ θανάτου ἡ ἁμαρτία δὲ ἡ δύναμις τῆς ἁμαρτίας ὁ νόμος
verses.transliteration: de To kentron tou thanatou hē hamartia de hē dynamis tēs hamartias ho nomos
verses.literal: - The sting - of death [is] - sin and the power - of sin [is] the law

verses.original: δὲ χάρις τῷ Θεῷ τῷ διδόντι ἡμῖν τὸ νῖκος διὰ ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: de charis tō Theō tō didonti hēmin to nikos dia hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: But thanks [be] to God who gives us the victory through our - Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: Ὥστε μου ἀγαπητοί ἀδελφοί γίνεσθε ἑδραῖοι ἀμετακίνητοι πάντοτε περισσεύοντες ἐν τῷ ἔργῳ τοῦ Κυρίου εἰδότες ὅτι ὑμῶν ὁ κόπος ἐν Κυρίῳ ἔστιν οὐκ κενὸς
verses.transliteration: Hōste mou agapētoi adelphoi ginesthe hedraioi ametakinētoi pantote perisseuontes en tō ergō tou Kyriou eidotes hoti hymōn ho kopos en Kyriō estin ouk kenos
verses.literal: Therefore my beloved brothers be steadfast [and] immovable Always excel in the work of the Lord because you know that your - labor in [the] Lord is not in vain
